verdicts.evidence: repro/A2-verify/a2-verify.test.ts 'A2-01a' (passes on 62f53dec, PG18 :55712): PO line qty 4 sold out by SO-1 Done -> status Sold qty 4; manager PATCH /api/inventory/:id {status:'Done'} -> 200 (inventory.ts:1376 accepts Sold->Done; the only status guard, inventory.ts:1461-1467, checks committed claims, which a Done SO no longer holds); SO-2 for the same 4 units then reaches Done: 8 units sold from a 4-unit lot. 'A2-01b': In Transit line PATCHed to Done -> discard 409, but POST /transfer-orders/:id/receive -> 200 and the TO becomes Received.
verdicts.reason: Part (a) reproduced: a manager can resurrect a sold-out lot and sell it twice (reachable from DesktopInventoryEdit.tsx:823, whose dropdown offers Done/Reviewing). Part (b) is overstated: the transfer is not stuck, receive skips the edited line but closes the TO. Part (c) is by design: inventory.ts:1458-1460 states a line on a mere Draft SO stays editable and is re-validated at promotion. P2 stands on (a) alone: manager-only and deliberate, so not P1.

verdicts.evidence: repro/A2-verify/a2-verify.test.ts 'A2-02': PO in WH-A2V, transfer to WH-DAL (TO Pending, event detail.from='WH-A2V'); DELETE /api/warehouses/WH-A2V (no transferTo) -> 200, nulls transfer_orders.from_warehouse_id (warehouses.ts:349); DELETE /api/inventory/transfer-orders/:id -> 500 (inventory.ts:2192 origin = from_warehouse_id ?? detail.from = deleted id -> FK violation), line stays In Transit; POST .../receive -> 200.
verdicts.reason: Discard 500s as claimed, but not 'forever': receive still works and lands the goods at the destination, so the transfer and its lines are not stranded. Needs a manager to delete a warehouse with a pending outbound transfer and then choose discard over receive: narrow, with a workaround, so P3.

verdicts.evidence: repro/A2-verify/a2-verify.test.ts 'A2-03': manager A archives PO -> 409 naming only SO-1 (Draft); manager B creates SO-2 on the same lot and moves it to Shipped; A re-posts archive {removeFromSellOrders:true} -> 200; SO-2 (still Shipped) now has 0 sell_order_lines. Cause: lifecycle.ts:190 reduces the confirmation to a boolean and orderAdvance.ts:385-400 recomputes the claimed set at confirm time across all open statuses incl. Shipped.
verdicts.reason: Stale-confirm deletion reproduced exactly as described. The deadlock (40P01) variant was not reproduced and looks guarded: orderAdvance.ts:374-380 takes the sell_orders rows FOR NO KEY UPDATE before the lines, in the documented sell-order-save order. Needs two managers to act on the same PO during one open dialog, so P3 rather than P2. The fix (echo the confirmed solIds and refuse on mismatch) is cheap.
